description: query-service.md names an Optimizer as an internal component of the Query Service, with no link to the cost-based optimizer, which the registry already holds as n1ql:cost-based-optimizer (promoted from the reference tree, where it is edition-gated and configurable). Nothing on the page states that the component and the CBO are the same thing, so the extraction minted query-service:optimizer separately and did not merge them - correct under the never-merge-without-evidence rule, and exactly the situation a one-sentence cross-reference on the page would resolve. Note the two are probably not identical: the CBO is an Enterprise feature, while every Query Service has an optimizer of some kind.
